newsitem.title: USA: Toshiba America Electronic names chairman.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba America Electronic names chairman.

text.p: Toshiba America Electronic Components Inc, the U.S.-based unit of Japanese electronics maker Toshiba Corp, Monday named Hideo Ito as chairman and chief executive officer, replacing Takeshi Nakagawa.
In a statement, Toshiba America said Nakaga has moved on to the position of corporate representative, Asia, for the parent company.
Ito was most recently general manager, sales and marketing of Toshiba Corp Semiconductor Group, where he had global sales responsibility for semiconductors and liquid crystal displays.
